title: Native canary durable sender cold configuration and existing exact wire

binding.description: These selectors must match separately admitted current intake/delivery assignments in the full independently root-signed configuration. Native boot/key/binary/policy and generated TLS are obtained from actual retained owners, never these strings.

recoveryTarget.description: Untrusted selectors, not prior ownership or permission. Cold startup performs only independently admitted completed recovery reads. Prepared/claimed/unknown history never creates a sender, expected-head continuation or contact permit.

configuration.description: Explicit cold profile only, no environment/HTTP/default selection. Public root and exact original pins are independently admitted with the native startup closure. Full signed authority bytes are retained (<=3 MiB), not policy bytes inferred from a custody digest. No secret TLS key is supplied. Original policy/custody lifetime remains fixed. Root owns additive outer v19 selection after v18; this schema never changes older closed profiles.

$comment: Schema data is not authority. Runtime owns immutable original bytes, role-4 signing, generated TLS, stable protected slot/head, complete signed planner/executor/witness originals, seven-root radix recomputation, and irreversible local claim/intake attempt state. No retry, split, re-signing, expiry renewal or unknown-head bypass. Whole response <=6 MiB, prepare/read completion <=768 KiB, combined claim originals <=1536 KiB, complete request <=3 MiB. Real twelve-kind exporters and runtime acceptance remain separate requirements.
